question_text: A rectangle's length is twice its width. The perimeter is 54 meters. What is the width?

A.text: You might have chosen A because after solving w=9, you mistakenly subtracted 2, getting 7.

B.text: You might have chosen B because off by one, nagbawas ng 1 after solving w=9.

C.text: Correct. w=9, so length=18 and perimeter=2(9+18)=54.

D.text: You might have chosen D because after w=9, you added 1, thinking you needed to round up.

next_time_rule: Rectangle perimeter: P=2(l+w). I-substitute l in terms of w, then solve P=2(2w+w)=6w. Pag nakuha na w, yun na mismo ang sagot. Huwag mag-add/subtract pa.
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay garden ni Aling Nena, ang length ay twice the width. Perimeter ng garden ay 54 meters. Let width = w, length = 2w. Gamitin ang formula P=2(l+w)=2(2w+w)=2(3w)=6w. Set 6w=54, so w=9.

I-check: kung width=9, length=18, perimeter talaga 2(9+18)=54. Tama! Kadalasan ang mali sa distractor ay nag-add o subtract after makuha ang w, o maling operation sa pagsolve ng equation. Always trust the algebra.
